name: fatty_acid_synthesis
description: De novo fatty acid synthesis. Cytosolic pathway that builds palmitate from acetyl-CoA. Requires NADPH and is highly regulated at ACC.

nodes.label: Acetyl-CoA (mitochondria)
nodes.notes: Cannot cross the inner mitochondrial membrane directly.

nodes.label: Citrate
nodes.notes: Shuttle form that carries acetyl units to the cytosol.

nodes.label: Growing Acyl-ACP chain
nodes.notes: Attached to Acyl Carrier Protein during synthesis.

nodes.label: Palmitate (C16:0)
nodes.notes: Primary end product of mammalian FAS.

edges.notes: Acetyl-CoA + OAA → Citrate (same as TCA entry). Citrate is exported when energy is high.
Cytosolic cleavage of citrate regenerates acetyl-CoA + OAA.
Requires biotin. Malonyl-CoA also inhibits CPT-I, preventing simultaneous β-oxidation.
Multifunctional enzyme. Each cycle: condensation → reduction → dehydration → reduction. Adds 2 carbons per cycle. Requires 2 NADPH per cycle.
Releases free palmitate when the chain reaches 16 carbons.
